annotations.title: Search how-to guides of the Barmaan panel

description: Searches the how-to guides of the Barmaan admin panel and customer portal that YOUR account may open (the role is read from your login, not from input). Use when the user asks how to do something in the Barmaan panel; include_steps returns full steps for the top 3 results. It explains only and performs no action. A guide marked needs_review may not match the current screens, so tell the user.

include_steps.description: true = full steps for the top 3 results, so one call answers 'how do I do X'.

locale.description: Language of the answer. Default: the language of your account. zh and ru fall back to English text.

module.description: Area of the guides, for example accounting, sales, catalog, portal.

query.description: What the user wants to do, in their own words and language.

name: help_search
title: Search how-to guides of the Barmaan panel
